title: words that i wanted to tell you

chunks.text:
hi T,

i went to therapy today and talked to Steph about us. you know, i hadn't had a real chance to fully process your abrupt disappearance from this realm, but for some reasons <small>(i was thinking about our relationship and how it shaped the way i see love in others, and how it framed the way i show up for people i care about. _maybe this is why i found it hard to get over H for the past few months._)</small> i decided to share this part of my life with Steph.

You know, we were so young.
